clips.title: The story
paras: Along Tirisfal Glades' western coast, the Whispering Shore lies north of Solliden Farmstead, its waters claimed by hostile murlocs.

Before the Third War, Lordaeron's fishermen came to the Whispering Shore for calm waters and plentiful catches. Now the Great Sea breaks against an empty coast, and the water is cold and dark. Travelers coming down from the hills risk an ambush from the murlocs along the shore.

A band of hostile murlocs claims the beach and attacks anyone who approaches the surf. Their chieftain, Muad, leads them as they guard the shallows and tidal flats, threatening nearby roads and Solliden Farmstead.
